CRITICAL RULES (violating these fails the whole benchmark):
- The binary is /workspace/executable (lz4 v1.10.0 CLI). You may ONLY run it and observe stdout/stderr/exit codes/output files.
- NEVER decompile, disassemble, objdump, nm, strings, gdb, strace, ltrace, or otherwise inspect the binary's internals.
- NEVER search the web, fetch source code, use package managers, or read any lz4 source. Do not install lz4.
- Only interact through the normal CLI interface.
- 'strings' and 'nm' on /workspace/executable are FORBIDDEN.

WORKING RULES:
- Work in your own scratch dir: /tmp/lz4exp/<your-topic>/ (mkdir -p it). Use ABSOLUTE paths everywhere.
- Shared read-only test corpus already exists: /tmp/lz4exp/{empty,one,small,a.txt,zeros64k,rand1m} and /workspace/assets/sample.txt.lz4
- Create your own extra test files as needed inside your scratch dir.
- 'xxd' is NOT installed; use 'od -A d -t x1' or python3 for hex dumps.
- Capture stdout and stderr SEPARATELY (e.g. cmd >out 2>err; echo $?) and record EXACT text including trailing spaces and newlines. Use 'od -c' when whitespace matters.
- Be exhaustive and systematic. Try edge cases, invalid inputs, weird combinations.
- Write your detailed findings to /tmp/lz4exp/notes/<topic>.md (mkdir -p /tmp/lz4exp/notes). Include verbatim transcripts.


YOUR TOPIC: roundtrip-fuzz
Write notes to /tmp/lz4exp/notes/roundtrip-fuzz.md

Probe ROUND-TRIP correctness of /workspace/executable across a wide matrix, to define the behaviour contract.
Generate ~20 varied inputs with python3 (empty, 1 byte, 255, 256, 65535, 65536, 65537, 4MB-1, 4MB, 4MB+1, 8MB, all-zeros, all-0xFF, random, text, highly-repetitive, sawtooth, alternating blocks of random+zeros).
For each, compress with a matrix of options (levels 1,3,9,12; -B4,-B7; -BD; -BX; --no-frame-crc; --content-size; -l) and decompress, verifying md5 equality. Report ANY mismatch or error. Also record, in a compact table, the compressed SIZE for each (input, options) pair -- this is a useful fingerprint for validating a reimplementation. Save the table to /tmp/lz4exp/notes/sizes.tsv as well.
Keep total runtime under ~10 minutes; avoid files >8MB except one.

When done, RETURN a dense summary (<=120 lines) of the most important, exactly-reproducible facts a reimplementer needs. Include exact message strings in quotes. Do not include filler.

import os, subprocess, hashlib, sys, shlex
EXE="/workspace/executable"
IN="/tmp/lz4exp/roundtrip-fuzz/in"
WK="/tmp/lz4exp/roundtrip-fuzz/wk"
os.makedirs(WK, exist_ok=True)

OPTS = [
 ("L1",            ["-1"]),
 ("L3",            ["-3"]),
 ("L9",            ["-9"]),
 ("L12",           ["-12"]),
 ("L1_B4",         ["-1","-B4"]),
 ("L9_B4",         ["-9","-B4"]),
 ("L1_B7",         ["-1","-B7"]),
 ("L1_B5",         ["-1","-B5"]),
 ("L1_B6",         ["-1","-B6"]),
 ("L1_BD",         ["-1","-BD"]),
 ("L9_BD",         ["-9","-BD"]),
 ("L1_B4_BD",      ["-1","-B4","-BD"]),
 ("L9_B4_BD",      ["-9","-B4","-BD"]),
 ("L1_BX",         ["-1","-BX"]),
 ("L9_B4_BX",      ["-9","-B4","-BX"]),
 ("L1_nocrc",      ["-1","--no-frame-crc"]),
 ("L9_nocrc",      ["-9","--no-frame-crc"]),
 ("L1_csize",      ["-1","--content-size"]),
 ("L12_csize",     ["-12","--content-size"]),
 ("L9_B4_BD_BX_cs_nocrc", ["-9","-B4","-BD","-BX","--content-size","--no-frame-crc"]),
 ("L1_favor",      ["-1","--favor-decSpeed"]),
 ("L12_favor",     ["-12","--favor-decSpeed"]),
 ("L1_fast",       ["--fast"]),
 ("Lfast17",       ["--fast=17"]),
 ("legacy",        ["-l"]),
 ("legacy_L9",     ["-l","-9"]),
]

def md5f(p):
    h=hashlib.md5()
    with open(p,'rb') as f:
        for c in iter(lambda:f.read(1<<20), b''): h.update(c)
    return h.hexdigest()

def run(args):
    r=subprocess.run([EXE]+args, capture_output=True)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr

inputs = sorted(os.listdir(IN))
rows=[]
problems=[]
srcmd5={n: md5f(os.path.join(IN,n)) for n in inputs}
srcsz={n: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(IN,n)) for n in inputs}

for name in inputs:
    src=os.path.join(IN,name)
    for oname, oargs in OPTS:
        cfile=os.path.join(WK, f"{name}.{oname}.lz4")
        dfile=os.path.join(WK, f"{name}.{oname}.out")
        rc,so,se = run(oargs+["-f", src, cfile])
        if rc!=0:
            problems.append(("COMPRESS_FAIL", name, oname, rc, se.decode('utf8','replace')))
            rows.append((name, srcsz[name], oname, -1, "CFAIL"))
            continue
        csz=os.path.getsize(cfile)
        rc2,so2,se2 = run(["-d","-f",cfile,dfile])
        if rc2!=0:
            problems.append(("DECOMP_FAIL", name, oname, rc2, se2.decode('utf8','replace')))
            rows.append((name, srcsz[name], oname, csz, "DFAIL"))
            continue
        ok = md5f(dfile)==srcmd5[name]
        if not ok:
            problems.append(("MD5_MISMATCH", name, oname, 0, f"got {md5f(dfile)} want {srcmd5[name]} dsz={os.path.getsize(dfile)}"))
        # -t test integrity
        rc3,_,se3 = run(["-t",cfile])
        tstat = "OK" if rc3==0 else f"TFAIL{rc3}"
        if rc3!=0:
            problems.append(("TEST_FAIL", name, oname, rc3, se3.decode('utf8','replace')))
        rows.append((name, srcsz[name], oname, csz, ("OK" if ok else "MD5BAD")+("" if tstat=="OK" else "/"+tstat)))
        os.remove(dfile)

with open("/tmp/lz4exp/notes/sizes.tsv","w") as f:
    f.write("input\tinput_size\toptions\tcompressed_size\tstatus\n")
    for r in rows: f.write("\t".join(str(x) for x in r)+"\n")

print("ROWS", len(rows))
print("PROBLEMS", len(problems))
for p in problems[:60]: print(p)
